question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ambigous"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Ambiguous"**. (अस्पष्ट)

 
 
• **Example:** The instructions she gave were **ambiguous**, causing confusion among the team members.
 
 
 
• The correct word **"Ambiguous"** means open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning. (अस्पष्ट)
 
 
• **Example:** His response was so **ambiguous **that I couldn't tell whether he was pleased or upset.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Luminous** (प्रकाशमान): Emitting or reflecting light, glowing; illuminating.

 
 
• **Example:** The luminous stars lit up the night sky.
 
 
 
• **Gregarious** (सामाजिक): Fond of company; sociable.
 
 
• **Example:** She was a gregarious person who enjoyed the company of others.
 
 
 
• **Nostalgia** (स्मृतिलाभ): A sentimental longing or wistful affection for the past, typically for a period or place with happy personal associations.
 
 
• **Example:** Listening to old songs filled him with nostalgia for his childhood.
